EnvironmentAgent.description: EnvironmentAgent defines one agent variant and the classes available for that variant in a territory behavior.

chance.description: Chance is the selection weight for this agent variant.

item.description: Items provide agent-specific settings consumed by the selected behavior.

spawn.description: Spawns are the game classes this agent variant can create.

type.description: Type is the agent variant used by this block, such as `Male` or `Female`.

EnvironmentFile.description: EnvironmentFile configures territory profiles, their spawn behaviors, and the files that provide their zones in `cfgenvironment.xml`.

env.description: XMLName identifies the required `<env>` document root.

territories.description: Territories declares territory behaviors, zone sources, and the agent classes that can populate those territories.

EnvironmentItem.description: EnvironmentItem stores one behavior-specific setting as a named text value.

name.description: Name is the setting key interpreted by the selected territory behavior.

val.description: Value is the setting value encoded as text.

EnvironmentSpawn.description: EnvironmentSpawn assigns a game class and selection weight to a territory agent variant.

chance.description: Chance is the selection weight for this class within its agent variant.

configName.description: ConfigName is the game class name that may be spawned.

EnvironmentTerritories.description: EnvironmentTerritories configures territory spawning systems by including territory data files and binding those files to spawn behaviors.

file.description: Files declares territory files that can be referenced by a territory's usable identifier.

territory.description: Territories bind a territory profile to its script behavior, zone data, agent classes, and behavior-specific settings.

EnvironmentTerritory.description: EnvironmentTerritory connects a named territory profile to the behavior that consumes its zones and agent definitions.

agent.description: Agents define the agent variants and game classes that may spawn in the territory.

behavior.description: Behavior is the Enforce Script behavior class that implements this territory's runtime logic.

file.description:
Files select the territory-zone data used by this profile.
Entries can refer to paths directly or to usable identifiers declared above.

item.description: Items provide named, behavior-specific settings as text values.

name.description: Name identifies the profile used by the corresponding Central Economy spawner or event configuration.

type.description: Type selects the territory system category, such as `Herd` or `Ambient`.

EnvironmentTerritoryFile.description: EnvironmentTerritoryFile selects territory-zone data for a territory profile.

path.description: Path is the direct path to a territory data file.

usable.description: Usable references a reusable territory file declaration by its identifier.
